overview: The Bug Tracker is a single-page application built with Express.js (backend) and vanilla JavaScript (frontend). Bugs are persisted as flat JSON files in data/. The frontend uses client-side routing with a component-based architecture. The app has three main views: a dashboard with summary statistics, a filterable bugs list, and a bug detail/edit view. Status transitions are handled via a dedicated PATCH endpoint.
